mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates broad economic weakness that reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in RSAFS and INDPRO occurs but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), higher interest rates reduce equity valuation multiples, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 2.0% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) over the past month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS increases but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) fall below 490,000 million dollars, it indicates weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS < 490000 but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals contractionary monetary policy combined with weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint condition of RSAFS decline and FEDFUNDS increase occurs but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial contraction (INDPRO < 107.0), manufacturing slowdowns reduce corporate output and earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 107.0 but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.
